The tests exercise Jing public validation APIs, use a separate version-agnostic test package, and contain no scaffold, Native Image skip/tolerance, visibility bypass, legacy metadata format, or native build/run flag. The reported dynamic-access result is N/A (0/0), so the percentage and entry-count mismatch gates do not apply. Index validation passed, and the stable Forge finalization pass completed all three native lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and statistics generation without another publishable change.
